prompts.prompt: Wide shot of a Stockholm theatre auditorium with warm house lights fading as a lone actress in a long coat crosses a dimly lit proscenium stage at Dramaten, gilded balconies framing the scene under soft amber glow.

Medium shot of a woman in a vintage dress standing center stage at Oscarsteatern under a single warm spotlight, gesturing with one hand while the orchestra pit below sits in shadow during a dramatic moment of the musical.

Behind-the-scenes view of Kulturhuset Stadsteatern's black box theatre, a director in a knit sweater leaning over a script table while two actors in rehearsal clothes mark blocking under cool worklight illumination, cables coiled on the wooden floor.

Close-up of an actor's hands gripping the edge of a worn wooden chair on a sparse stage, knuckles tense, warm tungsten side-light catching dust in the air and the rough texture of period costume fabric.
